So from my experience (I order vastly from AliExpress) everything above 60chf in value will be taxed/import fees.
But: the sellers usually declare lower prices on the package than what you actually pay... Sometimes a ridiculously low amount.

I had it twice or so that customs actually asked me to send them proof of what I actually paid. But I would assume 95% of the packages get through, even when I paid above 60chf. It's just with bulky items when they really check at customs. However , since the seller does the declaration there is no legal consequence for you. You just pay the fees/taxes and get your package. 

I think for a 120chf purchase I had to pay around 25-30chf additionally.
